Tooltip: Process of login procedure to confins R3 using the credential provided. The process opens the confins R3 login page, enters the required username and password, then click button submit, input otp code from microsoft outlook 365, and verifies that the user has successfully logged in.

Arguments.Name: UrlConfinsR3
Arguments.Tooltip: Url to login into confins R3.

Arguments.Name: Username
Arguments.Tooltip: Username for login into confins R3.

Arguments.Name: Password
Arguments.Tooltip: Password for login into confins R3.

Arguments.Name: IsDevelopment
Arguments.Tooltip: Flag to differentiation between process in production and development environment. If it's true then process login will skip process get otp code from email.

Arguments.Name: MaxRetryLogin
Arguments.Tooltip: Maximum number of retries process login into confins R3. The default value is 2.

Arguments.Name: IntervalRetryLogin
Arguments.Tooltip: Interval in seconds to retries process login into confins R3. The default value is 5 seconds.

Arguments.Name: TimeoutCheckStatusMessage
Arguments.Tooltip: Timeout in seconds of check app state status message to get error status message in confins R3. The default value is 20 seconds.

Arguments.Name: TimeoutCheckPageOTP
Arguments.Tooltip: Timeout of check element exists field input in page OTP confins R3. The default value is 30 seconds.

Arguments.Name: OrchestratorFolderPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Specifies the full orchestrator folder path where should access assets orchestrator resources for get the client secret used in microsoft outlook 365. Leave empty to used the current folder.

Arguments.Name: ClientSecretAssetName
Arguments.Tooltip: Specifies the name of the orchestrator credential asset used to retrieve authentication credential for microsoft 365. The asset must exist in the specified orchestrator folder.

Arguments.Name: TenantID
Arguments.Tooltip: The Microsoft Entra Tenant ID for the Microsoft 365 application. Used together with the Client ID to authenticate and authorize access to Microsoft 365 resources.

Arguments.Name: ClientID
Arguments.Tooltip: Microsoft Entra Application Client ID required for Outlook 365 authentication. This value is obtained from the App Registration in Microsoft Entra ID and is used to establish a secure connection to Microsoft 365.

Arguments.Name: MaxIterationGetOTP
Arguments.Tooltip: Maximum iteration do while to get the OTP mail messages before thrown an exception. The default value is 180 seconds.

Arguments.Name: OTP_TopMail
Arguments.Tooltip: The number of mail messages OTP to be retrieved. The default value is 30.

Arguments.Name: OTP_MailAccount
Arguments.Tooltip: Account outlook used for get the OTP message. If empty/null then used the default account in outlook.

Arguments.Name: OTP_Folder
Arguments.Tooltip: Folder in outlook for get the OTP message. The default value is 'Inbox'.

Arguments.Name: OTP_Subject
Arguments.Tooltip: Subject mail outlook for filter OTP mail.

Arguments.Name: OTP_RegexPattern
Arguments.Tooltip: The regex pattern to get OTP number.

Arguments.Name: EnableUIFallback
Arguments.Tooltip: Enables get OTP code with Outlook UI automation as a fallback when the Outlook 365 API method is fails.

Arguments.Name: OutlookAppPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Optional. Specifies the file system path to the Microsoft Outlook application executable used for UI automation when the UI fallback is enabled.
